title: Account
subtitle: Identity and Minecraft linking.
sessions_desc: Review browser sessions signed in to the current account. Revoke any unrecognized device session.
sessions_staff_idle: Operations account sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
sessions_empty: No devices are signed in with a panel session.
sessions_sign_out_others_title: Sign out all other device sessions?
sessions_sign_out_others_desc: Sessions on all devices except the current device will be invalidated. Sign-in will be required again.
sessions_signed_out_others_one: The session on {{count}} other device has been signed out.
sessions_signed_out_others_other: Sessions on {{count}} other devices have been signed out.
api_tokens_desc: An API key calls the Felis API as this account. Store it as securely as a password.
api_tokens_off: The platform owner has not enabled API keys.
api_tokens_empty: No API keys have been created.
api_token_create_desc: The key is shown once, immediately after it is created.
api_token_name_hint: 1 to 64 characters that identify where the key is used.
api_token_admin_risk: The key carries this account's administrative permissions on the admin console. It works only on the admin console domain and cannot be used for operations that require identity verification.
api_token_revoke_desc: Scripts that use this key stop working immediately. A revoked key cannot be restored.
api_token_created_desc: Copy the key for “{{name}}” and store it in a safe place.
api_token_created_warning: The key cannot be viewed again after this dialog is closed.
api_token_copy_failed: The key could not be copied automatically. Select it and copy it manually.
linked_desc: The Minecraft account is linked. Server claiming, starting, stopping, and other authorized management operations are available.
step1_desc_prefix: Connect to a server and run
step1_desc_suffix: . After identity verification, the server provides a one-time binding code valid for approximately 10 minutes.
email_desc: Verify the registered email address for account authentication.
email_step1_desc: Enter the email address to register and request a verification code.
email_step2_desc: Enter the six-digit verification code from the email. The code is valid for 10 minutes.
passkeys_desc: Passkeys provide panel sign-in using a fingerprint, facial recognition, or device PIN.
passkey_delete_desc: Deleting “{{name}}” (registered {{created}}) prevents further sign-in with this key and signs out sessions on other devices. The key can be registered again if required.
passkey_last_hint: The account has only one Passkey and no verified email address. Removing it would eliminate the available sign-in method. Verify an email address or register another Passkey first.
migration_desc: Transfer all servers owned by a retired account to the current account. Initiate migration in-game and complete it in the panel.
migration_none_prefix: No migration in progress. To move this account's servers to another account, run
migration_none_suffix: in-game on the account being retired.
migration_confirm_desc: Migration retires this account, so it needs a step-up check first.
migration_confirm_otp_btn: Send a code to my email
migration_issue_desc: Enter the Account ID displayed on the destination account page, then issue a one-time transfer code.
migration_issue_deadline: Issue the code before {{time}}. Identity confirmation is valid only in the current browser and must be repeated after expiry. A notification will be sent to the verified email address after issuance.
migration_code_desc: Sign in to the destination account and redeem this code before it expires.
migration_code_pending: A transfer code has been issued. Redeem it from the destination account before it expires
migration_redeem_desc: Redeem the transfer code issued by the source account to transfer its servers to the current account.
migration_redeemed: Migration complete — {{count}} server(s) moved to this account.
reauth_desc: This operation requires identity verification. Use a registered Passkey or verified email address. Verification remains valid for five minutes.
reauth_sign_in_desc: Operator accounts can also sign out and sign in again. A fresh sign-in counts for 5 minutes.
reauth_sign_in_btn: Sign out and sign in again
reauth_done_continue: Identity verified. Select Continue to add a Passkey.
email_change_desc: Enter the new email address to receive a verification code. After verification, sign-in codes will be sent to the new address, a change notification will be sent to the previous address, and sessions on other devices will be signed out.
staff_linked_desc: This profile is linked to the current administrator account. Its management identity is recognized when joining the game.
staff_link_desc: Link a Minecraft profile to identify its management role when joining the game. Panel administration does not require this link and it can be configured later.
staff_lookup_unsupported: This authentication source requires api_url for profile lookup. Panel administration remains available.
staff_confirm_desc: Link this profile to the current administrator account to identify its management role when joining the game.
staff_source_help: Yggdrasil is Minecraft’s account authentication protocol. Official and third-party providers use it to supply role profiles. Select the source used by your launcher and enter a role name or UUID, not an email.
game_version: Use Minecraft Java Edition {{version}} for the login server and lobby. Target servers may require another version or mods; check their instructions.
game_version_unknown: The login service client version is not configured. An operator must verify and set game_version. The panel version does not indicate the game version.
game_lobby: Players enter the lobby after authentication through the login service. The lobby provides server selection. Run /menu to open the server menu and wait for startup. Check the service list if the login service or lobby is not ready.
game_thirdparty: For a third-party source, configure the same provider in your launcher. Profile lookup reads an identity; joining still requires authentication with that provider.
staff_code_alternative: Use an in-game binding code when profile lookup is unavailable
